gen-gf-unkempt-gf-carme: Unkempt scrawls with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight, loose and bossy, while Carme sits tidy beneath. Rough swagger above, open-countered sans below: that gap is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-chakra-petch: Expressive from the first letter, Unkempt gives its t a crossbar and stem of matching weight. Chakra Petch keeps text moving with cupped round letters and a single stroke width, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Chiron Hei HK reads modern and professional, with a c like a bracelet pulled apart, beneath Unkempt's pencil-like lines. Unkempt does pencil-line attitude best; Chiron Hei HK does plain sans clarity.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-commissioner: Commissioner reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and every stroke at one thickness, set beneath Unkempt's loud, expressive headings. Unkempt shouts, Commissioner explains, and neither one talks over the other.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-didact-gothic: Rough meets tidy: Unkempt's t keeps crossbar and stem in matching weight, while Didact Gothic never snags on a closed-up bowl. A slightly larger size for Didact Gothic would suit its uniform strokes.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-dotgothic16: Wide channels lead into every counter, giving this sans-serif a friendly, tube-like thickness through each bend. DotGothic16 holds that steady line while Unkempt, expressive and commanding, takes the loud top spot.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-doto: Blueprint lettering meets generous space: Unkempt draws one constant line, and Doto gives each glyph wide margins around it. Plenty of space around every letter is what holds them together.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-el-messiri: Modest thick-thin contrast and a wide gap in the c make this sans read clean and modern. El Messiri would start to crowd loud Unkempt if the body grew large.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans reads like a ballpoint's pressure-free line, with a see-through gap in each s. And Unkempt, with its crossbar and stem matching in weight, sits next to it like a shout beside a murmur.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-encode-sans: Unkempt gives headings a texture of plain, unshaded lines, expressive and a bit commanding. Encode Sans keeps its c clearly apart from o, so its text size can drop a touch.
